locationPolicy.description: Use the coordinates belonging to the governorate selected and saved by the user in AL-HADITHI. Do not let IP geolocation, VPN, or ISP lookup silently replace that selection.

interpretation.null: No custom Maghrib angle/minute value supplied in the second slot
interpretation.4: Isha parameter in the third slot; it does not configure Maghrib
interpretation.tuneSixthValue: The sixth tune value is the Maghrib offset (+1 minute)

notes: The request calculation parameters are preserved exactly as supplied by the user. The original HTML uses approximate IP geolocation; the native Android integration uses the already-selected Iraqi governorate coordinates so the saved province setting remains authoritative. The six-value HTML display omitted Asr and Isha; the native screen keeps all five obligatory prayers and also displays sunrise, sunset, and midnight.
